parts.name: hair
parts.hint: The thin dark strand that grows up and out through the surface.

parts.name: hair follicle
parts.hint: The pocket in the skin that the strand grows from.

parts.name: sebaceous gland
parts.hint: The little lobes beside the strand that make oil to keep it soft.

parts.name: arrector pili muscle
parts.hint: The tiny strap that pulls the strand upright — goosebumps.

parts.name: sweat gland
parts.hint: The coiled tube deep down that makes sweat.

parts.name: sweat duct
parts.hint: The narrow tube carrying sweat up to a pore on the surface.

parts.name: artery
parts.hint: The red vessel bringing oxygen-rich blood to the skin.

parts.name: vein
parts.hint: The blue vessel taking used blood away from the skin.

parts.name: subcutaneous fat
parts.hint: The bubbly yellow layer at the bottom that keeps the body warm.

parts.name: epidermis
parts.hint: The thin outer layer you can see and touch.

parts.name: dermis
parts.hint: The thick middle layer that holds the vessels, glands and roots.
